name: localbridge
description: Local Bridge for VS Code: connect Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP clients to your workspace with authenticated tools for files, git, terminal, tests, and diagnostics.

commands.title: LocalBridge: Copy MCP Endpoint (with token, for Claude)

localbridge.autoStart.description: Deprecated: connections always start manually from Continue or Start in the sidebar. This setting is ignored.

localbridge.mcp.port.description: Local MCP HTTP port (0 = pick a free port).

localbridge.mcp.requireAuth.description: Require localbridge MCP token on every /mcp request. Set false only if your MCP client cannot send headers or URL tokens (less secure on ngrok).

localbridge.ngrok.enabled.description: When enabled, expose LocalBridge via a public HTTPS tunnel (ngrok or Cloudflare quick tunnel). When disabled (recommended), LocalBridge runs on localhost only.

localbridge.public.provider.description: Public HTTPS tunnel provider when localbridge.ngrok.enabled is true.

localbridge.cloudflared.path.description: Optional path to the cloudflared executable. Leave empty to use cloudflared from PATH (required for Cloudflare quick tunnels).

localbridge.ngrok.authtoken.description: ngrok authtoken. Also reads NGROK_AUTHTOKEN or a .env file next to the installed extension (see README).

localbridge.ngrok.domain.description: Optional reserved ngrok domain (static URL), e.g. my-app.ngrok-free.app. Also reads NGROK_DOMAIN from .vscode/.env. Falls back to a random ngrok URL if unavailable.

localbridge.maxWriteFileSize.description: Maximum content size (bytes) for write_file and create_file.

localbridge.maxSearchFileSize.description: Maximum file size (bytes) searched by search_file.

localbridge.auditLogEnabled.description: Record local audit metadata for MCP operations (no file contents or secrets).

localbridge.contextEnabled.description: Enable agent-independent shared project context tools.

localbridge.searchRespectGitignore.description: When true, search_file will respect .gitignore patterns (experimental).

localbridge.execution.maxStdoutBytes.description: Maximum stdout bytes returned from command execution.
